title: DHgate Cartier watch (review)
lesson: Story arc: L0-L5 are the problem (he wants it, can't afford it), L6 is the turn (DHgate), L7-L8 the reveal. Problem lines use the turntable spins (#0-#7): the watch as the dream object. Wearing/hands shots (#9, #11, #13) are saved for L8 'the quality was insane' because they are the payoff; using the wrist on L2 'always wanted to add to my collection' would spoil that he gets it later. L1 names a specific model he never filmed (Cartier Skeleton) and L4 names a car: real pictures with precise searches. L5 'unattainable' and L9 'let's go' have nothing literal to show: type only. L6 says DHgate: store page #14/#15. L7 'a fraction of the cost' is a price claim: the store page with the prices visible (#15) is the proof, not hands on the watch. Neighbouring lines start with different clips (#3, then #7, then #5).
input:

RULES
# Intro director rules (sent to Claude with every intro plan)

Add a line here whenever the user gives intro feedback; the next build follows it.

## All types
- Every line should SHOW the literal thing it says: the named product, place, car, brand, person or action.
- A line with nothing literal to show continues the shot before it, or is kinetic type only. Never random filler.
- Never repeat the same clip moment on two lines in a row.
- No dates, years or months on screen. No emojis. No generic cash/banknote stock.
- Pictures must be provably the thing: "Cartier" = a Cartier watch, never a place called Cartier.

## review (DHgate / product reviews)
- The creator's OWN B-roll (own=true) is the first choice for product lines. A long spin feeds several lines at different moments.
- Never the talking camera: a muted shot of him talking reads as lip-sync.
- Price lines ("costs $25,000"): the price-tag graphic carries it; show the real product or the store page, not cash.
- Comparison lines ("the same price as a brand new Kia"): a picture of THAT thing (the car), not the store page.
- Store/link/DHgate lines: the store page screen recording.
- Travel talk (airport, TSA, flight, suitcase): stock B-roll.
- Fewer repeats of the same product shot: mix own B-roll, product camera, store page, pictures and type-only beats.


For EVERY line choose one:
- {"show":"footage","clips":[indices in preference order]}  one of the creator's clips (look at the frames: only clips that really show what the line says; never a frame with a face talking)
- {"show":"picture","query":"<precise Wikimedia Commons search, e.g. 'Cartier Santos watch' or 'Kia Sportage car'>","kind":"photo|logo","word":"<the word in the line it lands on>"}  a real photo of a named thing the clips don't show
- {"show":"stock","query":"<2-3 word stock video search>"}  generic action/place B-roll (travel, shopping, delivery), at most 3 per intro
- {"show":"type"}  kinetic type only

Reply with ONLY JSON: {"lines":[{"i":0,"show":"...", ..., "why":"<8 words>"}, ...], "notes":"<one sentence on the intro as a whole>"}
